title: fix(plugin-approvals): ask the errors.* override with the negotiated locale, and interpolate an override once
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Hk8v45fyqE3ABq9r92EXwB)_

Fixes #34454

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：审批插件的两句拒绝提示(记录被审批锁定、非提交人撤回)在查部署自定义文案前，先把浏览器语言协商成服务里实际有的语言;渲染器对自定义文案只做一次占位符替换。
- 为什么改：浏览器发 `zh` 时，部署写好的 zh-CN 自定义锁定/撤回提示被跳过，用户看到的是内置句子;标题里带 `{{object}}` 这类文字时，会被二次替换成别的内容。
- 风险与回滚：只影响「有部署自定义 errors.* 文案」的提示文字;错误码、409/403 状态和 `CODE: message` 外形都不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/operation-message.ts`(renderOperationMessage 取覆盖模板不再传参数)、`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/lifecycle-hooks.ts`(refusalLocalization)、`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`(userFacingRefusal)。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run src/record-lock-user-facing-message.test.ts src/recall-refusal-user-copy.test.ts`,应看到 [#34454] 两组用例全绿(裸 zh 读到 zh-CN 自定义句子)。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The negotiated locale, for both override lookups.** The record-lock refusal (`409 RECORD_LOCKED`, `record_locked*`) and the non-submitter recall refusal (`approval_recall_not_submitter`) asked the `i18n` service for the deployment's `errors.KEY` override with the request tag as sent. `FileI18nAdapter.resolveFromLocale` matches tags exactly, so a bare `zh` writer missed a zh-CN override and read the built-in zh-CN sentence (around the zh-CN label, which was already asked with the negotiated tag). Both callers now negotiate first, the way objectql's catalog callers do (`negotiatedMessageLocale`):
  - `reader-locale-labels.ts`: the plugin's existing negotiation glue (formerly the private `negotiatedLocale` behind `readerLabelsFor`) is exported as `negotiatedReaderLocale` and shared. No second copy; the one rule stays `resolveBundleLocale`.
  - `lifecycle-hooks.ts` `refusalLocalization` returns the negotiated tag, so the label and the override are asked with the same tag.
  - `approval-service.ts` `userFacingRefusal` negotiates against `i18nServiceSource`, the same service `approvals-plugin.ts` wires behind `messageTranslator`. Without a service, or one that cannot list its locales, the tag passes through as before.
- **N2: one interpolation on the override path.** `renderOperationMessage` asked `translate(key, locale, params)`; `II18nService.t` interpolates the params it is handed, and the renderer interpolated the answer again. A value that itself contained a placeholder (a record title such as `Q{{object}}`) was expanded on the second pass. The renderer now asks for the template by key and locale, as its own docblock already states, and interpolates once. The built-in path was already single-pass and is unchanged.
- **N1:** the stray ` *` that glued two paragraphs of the `BUILTIN_OPERATION_MESSAGES` docblock is a blank comment line again.

## Tests

- `record-lock-user-facing-message.test.ts`, new top-level `describe` `[#34454]` on the file's real-engine rig (ObjectQL + sqlite + the real `beforeUpdate` hook), with a `FileI18nAdapter`-shaped double (exact tag match, `{{name}}` interpolation of `params`):
  - bare `zh` writer reads the deployment's zh-CN `errors.record_locked` override (`code` `RECORD_LOCKED`, `statusCode` 409, store unchanged);
  - CONTROL: zh-CN writer reads the same override;
  - a title `Q{{object}} {{title}}` is printed as written on the override path.
- `recall-refusal-user-copy.test.ts`, new top-level `describe` `[#34454]`, the service wired as `approvals-plugin.ts` wires it:
  - bare `zh` caller reads the zh-CN `errors.approval_recall_not_submitter` override, and the service was asked at `zh-CN`; request stays `pending`, `FORBIDDEN` prefix kept;
  - CONTROL: zh-CN caller; a locale the service does not hold reads the built-in ja-JP sentence.
- `operation-message.test.ts`: on the override path, with an interpolating translator, a title containing placeholders renders as written; CONTROL on the built-in path.
- Rework 1 (head 6724fe5d68), the one existing test this PR changes: `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-permission-refusal-override.test.ts`. The [#30797] dispatcher pin now asserts `t` is called as `('errors.permission_denied', 'zh-CN', undefined)`, the override template asked with no params, where it asserted `expect.anything()` for a third argument; the 'override is the message' assertion is unchanged. It also gains the module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata'` that `check:test-source-alias` prescribes. Of the 15 test files in the eight `renderOperationMessage` consumer packages that name an `errors.*` override, it was the only one asserting the third argument; all 15 pass at this head.

## Acceptance notes

- `renderValidationMessage` (`validation-message.ts`, outside this card's file surface) carries the same ask-with-params-then-interpolate shape. Its params are a field label, the API name and authored constraint values, not row content, so this PR leaves it as is.
- The pins went into the two existing harness files as top-level `describe` blocks rather than new files, per ruling record 6583487846 (a new pin for a component with a shared harness file goes into that file).

## Verification

<details><summary>Ablations (one per changed behaviour, committed fix first, restored and re-checked)</summary>

Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob moved), restored by the same tool; `git diff HEAD` empty afterwards. Each subject is imported from `src` by its test (no `dist` hop).

- `lifecycle-hooks.ts`: `negotiatedReaderLocale(service, requested)` → `requested`: 2 red (bare `zh` override; the `{{` title case, which also writes as `zh`).
- `approval-service.ts`: `negotiatedReaderLocale(service, context?.locale)` → `context?.locale`: 1 red (bare `zh` recall override), 13 green.
- `operation-message.ts`: `opts.translate(key, locale)` → `opts.translate(key, locale, params)`: 1 red (the `{{` title pin), 50 green.
</details>
